questions.questionText: hour Additional Materials: Multiple Choice Answer Sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST Write in soft pencil. Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid. Write your name, Centre number and candidate number on the Answer Sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you. DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are thirty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet.

The diagram shows two production possibility curves (EF and GH), before and after technological progress has taken place. G E consumer goods X O Y M F H capital goods After technological progress has taken place, what is the opportunity cost in capital goods of producing OX consumer goods?

options.A: MH B OH C OM D YF

questions.questionText: The table shows indicators for four countries undergoing a transition to a market economy. Which country has achieved the most indicators of a successful transition? exchange rate stock inward prices system exchange investment

A kitchen manufacturer wanted to become more efficient. It decided to move to an industrial estate and to increase the division of labour in the manufacture of its products. Which statement about the division of labour is correct?

options.A: It occurs only in manufacturing industry.
options.B: It occurs only in market economies.
options.C: It occurs only when similar firms are located in the same area.
options.D: It occurs only when workers become more specialised.

questions.questionText: What will cause a shift in the demand curve for a computer?

options.A: a change in the cost of production of the computer
options.B: a change in the price of the computer
options.C: a change in the performance of the computer
options.D: the imposition of a specific tax on the computer

questions.questionText: If the price of maize rises, the quantity of maize demanded should fall. If the demand for maize decreases, the price of maize should rise. What can be said about these two statements? first statement second statement
When the supply of a good decreases, equilibrium price stays the same. What is the price elasticity of demand of the good?

A product is an inferior good with no close substitutes. It is also a complement to good X. Which product matches the above description? cross elasticity of price elasticity income elasticity product demand with respect of demand of demand to the price of X
A supply curve is represented by the equation, quantity supplied = 10 + 5P, where P = the price of the product. Which price rise would cause the quantity supplied to double?

options.A: $1 to $2 B $1 to $3 C $1 to $4 D $1 to $5

questions.questionText: Firm Z is one of a number of firms producing televisions. What would cause firm Z’s supply curve to shift to the left whilst the market supply curve for televisions shifts to the right?

options.A: Firm Z benefits more from advances in technology than the other firms in the industry.
options.B: Firm Z experiences a strike whilst more firms enter the industry.
options.C: Firm Z passes on more of a tax to its customers than the other firms in the industry.
options.D: Firm Z reduces its costs of raw materials whilst other firms in the industry lower their wage costs.

What effect are these changes likely to have on the illegal market price of that drug and on the quantity consumed? illegal market quantity price consumed

Which is not an example of an externality?

options.A: The establishment of a new firm in an area increases the general level of wage rates in the area.
options.B: The flowers planted by a householder in his garden give pleasure to his neighbours.
options.C: The immunisation of children against smallpox reduces the danger of the risk of infection to others.
options.D: The installation of security cameras in a city centre results in an increase in thefts elsewhere.

options.B: abolition of tariffs between member countries
